{{Top|canon=Albinism}}
[[File:Jannik1.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Jannik (Rodian)|Jannik]], an albino [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]]]
'''Albino''' was a term to describe beings with abnormally pale skin, which&mdash;in [[Human/Legends|Humans]] at least&mdash;was caused by a lack of [[Wikipedia:Biological pigment|pigmentation]] of the skin. Albinism could affect a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]], from Humans, to [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Kath hound/Legends|Kath hounds]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

Albino Humans were said to be paler than [[Chev]]s.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> The [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]] [[Skakoan religion|worshiped]] an [[Albino Cyclops]]<ref name="Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops">{{StoryCite|story=Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> The Wookiee [[Tojjevvuk]] was an albino who battled [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] over the right to court the Wookiee [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]]. During the fight, he fell into the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] where his white fur made him easy prey for the many predators inhabiting the region.<ref name="Star Wars: Chewbacca 2000">[[Star Wars: Chewbacca (2000)|''Star Wars: Chewbacca'' (2000)]]</ref> Another albino Wookiee, [[Katykam]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Najarka]] when his client, [[Crying Dawn Singer]] was kidnapped by people who wished to create a rift between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Shashay]], Crying Dawn Singer's people.<ref name="A">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref> [[Oraalarri]] was also an albino Wookiee, who sought to spread the ideals of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]].<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}} {{C|Life Day 2004}}</ref> The Rodian clan leader, [[Jannik (Rodian)|Jannik the White]], was also an albino.<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones]]''</ref> [[Vianna D'Pow]] was an albino Zeltron bounty hunter during the Rise of the Empire era. [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavenen]] female [[Caet Shrovl]] was albino, which she believed resulted from some kind of experiment which the Empire performed on her mother.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
